method: Standalone exact-candidate mounted witness using public practice routes and real task controls; supports both levels, visual/linear views, narrow and enlarged CSS root text plus wide normal reference. Records geometry, visible controls and overflow through prompts/help, feedback and completion. CSS text scaling is not browser zoom. This does not measure managed Start admission/scratch-preflight or certify fit; recorded geometry needs visual review.
